verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a broad app ecosystem (apps extending admin, checkout, storefront) and a theme marketplace (themes.shopify.com) covering long-tail customization, and community comments (e.g., comm-7) corroborate that a real, gated app-approval system exists. However, no evidence explicitly documents app-store curation/vetting criteria, ratings, or marketplace scale, and community reports (comm-7, comm-8) describe friction and opaque approval processes for developers. Missing for 10: explicit vetting/review process documentation, marketplace scale/quality metrics, independent hands-on merchant reviews of app discovery experience.
